transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I've been hearing voices that aren't actually there for about three months now, and it's really scaring me. On top of that, I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty inside for the last five months.
Have you ever heard these voices during times when your mood felt completely normal and you weren't feeling depressed?

Yes, I definitely have. There was a period of about three weeks where my mood actually felt completely stable and fine, but the voices were still there. It was strange because I wasn't feeling depressed at all during that time, but I still heard them clearly.
During those five months of feeling depressed, did you also experience other symptoms like a loss of interest in things you usually enjoy, changes in your sleep or appetite, or low energy?

Yes, during those five months, I completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love. I also had a really hard time eating because my appetite just completely dropped, and I barely wanted to eat anything.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days or more where you felt abnormally happy, energetic, or hyperactive, and felt like you didn't need much sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods where I felt abnormally happy or energetic, and my sleep has never been like that.
Apart from hearing voices, have you ever felt like people are watching you, plotting against you, or that your thoughts are being controlled by someone else?

Yes, actually, I feel that way quite a lot. I constantly feel like people are watching me and monitoring my every move, or even plotting to do something to me. It's really terrifying and makes it hard to trust anyone.
Over your entire lifetime, how long in total have you been experiencing these struggles with hearing voices or feeling paranoid?

I have been experiencing those specific struggles with the voices and paranoia for about three months. In total, though, my overall struggles with my mental health have been going on for about a year.

During the last five months while you have been feeling depressed, have the voices and the feeling of being watched also continued, or did they stop?

Yes, they did occur during my depression, but they didn't last the entire five months since those symptoms have only been going on for about three months. I've also experienced the voices and paranoia during times when I wasn't feeling depressed at all.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with concurrent symptoms of schizophrenia (hallucinations, paranoia, disorganized speech) and a major depressive episode. The psychotic symptoms have persisted for more than two weeks in the absence of a major mood episode (during the first seven months of the year, as well as a stable three-week period), ruling out Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features. The absence of any manic or hypomanic history specifies the Depressive Type of Schizoaffective Disorder.
